newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek shares trade mixed, volume slack.
newsitem.headline: Greek shares trade mixed, volume slack.

text.p: Greek stocks were virtually unchanged in quiet dealing early on Tuesday and analysts said thin volume at the peak of the summer vacation season was keeping a lid on prices.
"With trading volume standing at a fifth of its average value in previous months, prices of Greek equities do not reflect their potential," said George Dimitriou, analyst at Ergo Securities.

"There is ample scope for appreciation in banks and industrial stocks before they fully incorporate their accelerating profitability," he added. "The market has not evaluated correctly these stocks which have started to post spectacular improvement in their interim results."
Financial press reports see July CPI inflation easing to 5.4 percent from June's 5.5 percent. An offical announcement is expected on Wednesday.
The Athens general index was down 0.01 percent or 0.10 points to 1,586.75 from Monday's 1,586.85 close after 30 minutes of trading.
Turnover was 1.6 billion drachmas on volume of 0.6 million shares.
Decliners were leading advancers 55 to 52 with 28 shares unchanged on 135 traded.
OTE telecom Global Depository Shares (GDS) were quoted on London's SEAQ International market at $10.6-$11.2. Two GDSs make up one share of OTE.
The Merrill Lynch call spread warrant on OTE with a strike price of 3,800 drachmas, capped at 5,000 drachmas, was quoted at 1,119-1,149 drachmas.

The recently launched second Merrill Lynch call spread warrant on OTE with a strike price of 6,800 drachmas, capped at 10,000 drachmas, was quoted at 1,040-1,100 drachmas. The warrants expire December 16, 1998. Shares of the underlying stock was firmer 25 drachmas at 6,295.
The Merrill Lynch American call warrant on a basket of 23 Greek equities that are part of the Athens general index was quoted at 628.95-669.09 drachmas. The warrants expire January 9 1998.

The ING Baring Financial Products American style call warrant based on a basket of six bank stocks was quoted at $70.48-$73.22. The strike price is set at $99.60 and the warrants expire October 8, 1997.

The ING Baring Financial Products American-style call warrant on a basket of six blue-chips denominated in drachmas was quoted at 3,392-3,613 drachmas. The strike price is set at 10,000 drachmas and the warrants expire on February 2, 1998.
The ING Baring American-style second call warrant on a basket of six bank stocks was quoted at $10.65 bid/no offer. The strike price is set at $110.0 and the warrants expire April 9 1998.

The recently launched ING Baring American-style, drachma- denominated call warrant on the bourse's benchmark index was quoted at 222-253 drachmas. The strike price is set at 1,639 points and the warrants expire May 14 1998.
